description: Reconciliation of PACS cross-domain evaluation protocols: Ablation Baseline vs Primary ForensicNet

experiment_1_ablation_baseline.architecture: Standard CNN without high-pass filter (runs/resnet18_baseline or runs/nohp_ablation)
experiment_1_ablation_baseline.scientific_purpose: Demonstrates severe semantic domain collapse (Photo 0.83 -> Sketch 0.64) when standard CNN backbones lack the high-pass SRM front-end.
experiment_1_ablation_baseline.protocol: Standard resizing, 400 sources per domain, evaluated on ablation baseline checkpoint.

experiment_2_primary_forensicnet_calibra.scientific_purpose: Demonstrates that the fixed high-pass filter bank isolates watermark noise, preserving strong ranking discrimination (AUC 0.82-0.87) across styles, while revealing a 2.3-logit score deflation on cartoon/sketch.
experiment_2_primary_forensicnet_calibra.protocol: pacs_calibration.py, 200 sources per domain (400 samples), size 224, photo-calibrated threshold tau=1.3394.

experiment_2b_primary_forensicnet_full.scientific_purpose: Full-corpus verification confirming ranking preservation across all 1,600 PACS sources on the frozen primary model.

retention_policy: Both experiments are scientifically valid and retained as separate evaluations: Experiment 1 documents baseline semantic vulnerability; Experiment 2 documents ForensicNet ranking robustness and calibration gap.
